system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Generate a Kubernetes ConfigMap manifest storing an nginx.conf configuration file mounted into an nginx Deployment at /etc/nginx/conf.d/.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: Kubernetes manifest (YAML)

Task: Generate a Kubernetes ConfigMap manifest storing an nginx.conf configuration file mounted into an nginx Deployment at /etc/nginx/conf.d/.

Output only the Kubernetes manifest (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: nginx-conf
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: nginx
    app.kubernetes.io/component: web
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: nginx-app
data:
  nginx.conf: |
    server {
        listen 80 default_server;
        listen [::]:80 default_server;
        server_name _;

        # Log to stdout/stderr for containerized environments
        access_log /dev/stdout main;
        error_log /dev/stderr warn;

        location /healthz {
            return 200 'ok';
            add_header Content-Type text/plain;
        }

        location / {
            root   /usr/share/nginx/html;
            index  index.html index.htm;
            try_files $uri $uri/ =404;
        }

        # Security headers
        add_header X-Content-Type-Options nosniff;
        add_header X-Frame-Options DENY;
        add_header X-XSS-Protection "1; mode=block";
    }
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: nginx
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: nginx
    app.kubernetes.io/component: web
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: nginx-app
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: nginx
      app.kubernetes.io/component: web
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: nginx
        app.kubernetes.io/component: web
        app.kubernetes.io/part-of: nginx-app
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 101
        runAsGroup: 101
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: nginx
          image: nginx:1.25.5-alpine
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          ports:
            - containerPort: 80
              name: http
          volumeMounts:
            - name: nginx-conf
              mountPath: /etc/nginx/conf.d
              readOnly: true
            - name: nginx-run
              mountPath: /var/run
            - name: nginx-cache
              mountPath: /var/cache/nginx
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 50m
              memory: 64Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 500m
              memory: 256Mi
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /healthz
              port: http
            initialDelaySeconds: 5
            periodSeconds: 10
            timeoutSeconds: 2
            failureThreshold: 3
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /
              port: http
            initialDelaySeconds: 3
            periodSeconds: 10
            timeoutSeconds: 2
            failureThreshold: 3
      volumes:
        - name: nginx-conf
          configMap:
            name: nginx-conf
        - name: nginx-run
          emptyDir: {}
        - name: nginx-cache
          emptyDir: {}
